name: Bahia Relay Sidecar
description: Local Khatru relay sidecar for Bahia browser bootstrap and control-plane events.
posting_policy: Bahia sidecar-first control-plane relay: accepts authorized 596x requests, Bahia-signed 696x/796x/3196x projections, and configured open interop kinds. If mirror_external is enabled, this relay is the upstream boundary and Bahia will not also connect directly to mirrored public upstream relays.
